$description: What is enforced vs convention for token usage. Category keys match tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and real token-key prefixes (checked by verify_all.py).

rawValueRestrictions.text: never a raw colour; use a text.* role
rawValueRestrictions.surface: never a raw colour; use a surface.* role
rawValueRestrictions.border: never a raw colour; use a border.* role
rawValueRestrictions.type: never a raw font size/weight/line-height; use a type.* role
rawValueRestrictions.layout: never a raw padding/gap; use layout.*
rawValueRestrictions.motion: only motion.* (and only through the section's const-locked pattern)
rawValueRestrictions.component: component.* tokens are fixed by contracts

overrides: Enforced by absence: the PageSpec schema has no per-instance style/token-override field, so there is nothing for a generated page to override (MASTER-GUIDE 3.21). Token usage is owned by section/component contracts, whose `tokens` lists verify_all.py resolves against the real token files.
machineChecked: every catalog id exists in a token file
every {reference} inside a token value resolves
themes resolve to the foundation values they claim
convention: choosing among type.* roles for a new page is a design judgement, not machine-checked
